title: 第二章 后天四重！
slug: 武神空间全本免费-武神空间最新章节列表
content_zh:
虽然叶希文没有想过一来就称霸世界绝世无敌什么的，那都是歪歪小说而已，他所想的首先就是自保，然后将所有的耻辱都还回去，但是也不想一辈子都被困在这里。
又过了许久，叶希文实在是无聊的很，只好开始练起了内功，这个世界的武功分为武技和内功两个部分，他现在只有后天三重，还没有第四重，而按照宗内的规矩，第四重以前是不允许修炼武技的，原因很简单，武道修行，以内功为根本，内功无成，那这辈子也没有什么成就，而武道的前三重是打基础的阶段。
他发现，除了被困在这里之外，其他的一切都和在外面的时候一模一样。
不管怎么样，只有以不变应万变，修炼内功，提升自己的实力，也不会白白浪费了时间。
他现在修炼的这套功法，名叫《明玉功》，一共分十层，是宗内少数能够一路修行到先天境界的内功，也是全靠了叶空明长老的身份，叶希文才能修行到这套功法。
这套功法非常平和，正是最为平和不过的了。
陡然发现，对于《明玉功》的感悟居然不断的涌上心头，如果说以前的感悟速度是小溪流的速度的话，那么现在叶希文的感悟速度，绝对是长江黄河，奔涌不息。
无尽的感悟将叶希文填满，让他如痴如醉的一遍又一遍的搬运着真气，修炼着《明玉功》。
也不知道过去了多久。
“轰！”
叶希文猛然间惊醒过来，睁开眼睛，发现自己居然又出现在自己的房间中而不是那个混沌的空间了，外面的天已经蒙蒙亮了。
叶希文惊出一声冷汗，刚才那个空间难道只是梦境么？
但是在那个混沌空间中的感悟却又是极其清晰，根本不像是假的。
突然，叶希文发现，他削瘦的身体上被汗水浸湿，浑身都是一些黑色的杂质，这些都是隐藏在身体中的一些杂质，后天九重，每一次突破，都会排出一些杂质，一直到排除干净，身体空明之后，才会试着打通任督二脉，从后天返回先天。
这是突破了一重的现象啊，怎么会这样，叶希文惊愕不已，他自己估算着，以他的情况要突破后天四重，起码还需要小半年左右的样子，毕竟他的天资也就摆在那里而已。
但是这才在混沌时间中待了一夜的时间居然已经练到了第四重了。
难怪，按照前身的记忆，一般就算《明玉功》练一遍也都难有一点感悟，但是刚才在空间中演练《明玉功》的时候，大量的感悟和信息涌入脑海中，比起在现实中的推演速度何止快了百倍。
如果是这样的话，有了这个特殊空间的帮助，什么武学在叶希文眼中都不再是秘密，通过在这个特殊空间中的演练，叶希文能很快的掌握住武学的精髓！
叶希文一拳轰出，顿时震的空气一阵爆裂震动，一股劲在他的身体中游荡，全身的力量，不再是以往那样分散在全身，而是拧成了一股劲，比起以前，简直不可同日而语。
后天九境当中，第一重的武者，一拳轰出能有五十斤，第二重就是一百斤，第三重就是二百斤了，等突破到第四重，就能一口气增加到五百斤。

后天第四重是第一个分水岭，达到后天四重之后，力量达到五百斤，也就是一头猛虎之力，威猛之极。
一元宗中并不限制门下的弟子一定要修炼什么样的功法，因为一元宗中的功法本身就非常的多，每个弟子都可以找到适合自己的功法。
就算是外面得到的功法也不禁止，反而只认为这是弟子的机缘所在。
更重要的是，他的肉身经过了那五彩的光华的改造之后，经脉扩大了无数倍，如果说以前叶希文的经脉是小溪的话，那么改造之后的经脉就是长江黄河，真气在其中奔流不息。
这样子叶希文一天的修炼都比的上别人许多天的修炼成果，而且一般功法的威力和一瞬间能发出的真气数量有直接关系，叶希文经脉比一般人都要宽阔许多，同样的招式在叶希文的手中也远比其他人要厉害的多。
叶希文现在的力量直接突破到了五百七十斤。
叶希文顿时大喜，有了这个特殊空间的帮助，他才有可能脱颖而出，出人头地。

content_en:
Although Ye Xiwen didn't think about dominating the world and becoming invincible right away, those were just Wai Wai novels. What he wanted first was to protect himself and then return all the shame, but he didn't want to be trapped here for the rest of his life.
After a long time, Ye Xiwen was really bored, so he had to start practicing internal skills. The martial arts in this world are divided into two parts: martial arts and internal skills. He now only has the acquired third level, but not the fourth level. According to the rules of the sect, the fourth level was not allowed to practice martial arts before. The reason is very simple. Martial arts practice is based on internal strength. If internal strength is not achieved, there will be no achievements in this life, and the first three levels of martial arts are the stage of laying the foundation.
He found that except for being trapped here, everything else was exactly the same as when he was outside.
No matter what, as long as you stay the same to cope with the ever-changing changes, practice your inner strength, and improve your own strength, your time will not be wasted.
The set of exercises he is practicing now is called "Mingyu Gong". It has ten levels in total. It is one of the few internal exercises in the sect that can be practiced all the way to the innate realm. It is only because of the identity of Elder Ye Kongming that Ye Xiwen can practice this set of exercises.
This set of exercises is very peaceful, the most peaceful one can be.
Suddenly, he discovered that the comprehension of "Ming Yu Gong" kept coming to his mind. If the speed of comprehension before was the speed of a small stream, then the speed of Ye Xiwen's comprehension now is definitely that of the Yangtze and Yellow Rivers, rushing endlessly.
Ye Xiwen was filled with endless insights, making him move the Qi and practice the "Ming Yu Gong" over and over in a mesmerizing way.
I don’t know how much time has passed.
"Boom!"
Ye Xiwen woke up suddenly, opened his eyes, and found that he was in his room again instead of the chaotic space. It was already dark outside.
Ye Xiwen broke into a cold sweat. Was that space just a dream?
But the perception in that chaotic space was extremely clear, and it didn't look like a lie at all.
Suddenly, Ye Xiwen discovered that his thin body was soaked with sweat and covered with some black impurities. These were some impurities hidden in the body. The ninth level of the acquired world. Every time he broke through, some impurities would be discharged. Only after they were completely eliminated and the body was empty, would he try to open up the Rendu and Du meridians and return to the innate from the acquired.
This is the phenomenon of breaking through the first level. How could this happen? Ye Xiwen was shocked. He estimated that in his situation, it would take at least half a year to break through the fourth level. After all, his talent was only there.
But after just one night in the chaotic time, he had already reached the fourth level.
No wonder, according to the memory of the predecessor, it is generally difficult to gain any insights even if you practice "Mingyu Gong" once, but when you practiced "Mingyu Gong" in space just now, a large amount of insights and information poured into your mind, which was a hundred times faster than the deduction in reality.
If this is the case, with the help of this special space, any martial arts is no longer a secret in Ye Xiwen's eyes. Through practicing in this special space, Ye Xiwen can quickly master the essence of martial arts!
Ye Xiwen punched out, and the air suddenly exploded and shook, and a force of energy wandered through his body. The strength of the whole body was no longer scattered throughout the body as before, but was twisted into one force. Compared with before, it was simply incomparable.
Among the nine acquired realms, a warrior at the first level can punch fifty kilograms with one punch, the second level is a hundred kilograms, the third level is two hundred kilograms, and when he breaks through to the fourth level, he can increase it to five hundred kilograms in one breath.
The fourth acquired level is the first watershed. After reaching the acquired fourth level, the strength reaches 500 kilograms, which is the strength of a tiger, extremely powerful.
The Yiyuan Sect does not restrict what kind of exercises the disciples must practice, because the Yiyuan Sect hasThere are many exercises in itself, and each disciple can find a method that suits him or her.
Even the exercises obtained from outside are not prohibited. Instead, they are only regarded as opportunities for disciples.
What's more important is that after his body was transformed by the colorful brilliance, his meridians expanded countless times. If Ye Xiwen's meridians were like streams before, then after the transformation, his meridians were like the Yangtze and Yellow Rivers, with true energy flowing endlessly in them.
In this way, Ye Xiwen's practice in one day is better than the results of many days of practice by others, and the power of general exercises is directly related to the amount of Qi that can be emitted in an instant. Ye Xiwen's meridians are much wider than those of ordinary people, and the same moves in Ye Xiwen's hands are much more powerful than those of others.
Ye Xiwen's current strength has directly exceeded 570 kilograms.
Ye Xiwen was immediately overjoyed. With the help of this special space, he could stand out and stand out.
